subject: Request: Temporary night-handoff SLA exception and escalation routing
messages:
From: Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@greenleaf.health>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: support@greenleaf.health
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0400
Subject: Night coverage - temporary handoff waiver request

Hi Logan,

Quick background: GreenLeaf is onboarding an overnight batch ingestion job next week that will increase late-night traffic for two weeks while we run reconciliation. Our internal on-call is limited (rotations overlap with contractor time off), and we need a short-term SLA adjustment so Redwood's support team can accept initial P2s overnight and hand them back to us during our morning overlap window.

Specifically, we're asking for:
- A temporary P2 response window of 4 hours (current P2 SLA is 2 hours) for Oct 4 - Oct 17.
- Redwood to accept and acknowledge P1s immediately as normal.
- A documented handoff procedure for any P2s handled by Redwood overnight so we can triage in our morning shift.

We understand this is an exception request; we can provide access to our runbooks and a primary contact list. If helpful, I can jump on a quick call this afternoon.

Thanks,
Sam Ortiz
Director, Platform Operations
GreenLeaf Healthcare

Attachment: internal-incident-runbook.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@greenleaf.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Night coverage - temporary handoff waiver request

Sam —

Thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can accommodate a temporary exception, but want to lock down operational details and escalation paths before Oct 4. Proposed approach:

1) P1s: Redwood accepts and follows standard P1 process (immediate ack, P1 rota notified). No change.
2) P2s (Oct 4–17): Redwood will ACK inbound P2s within 1 hour and set initial triage; Redwood will aim to resolve overnight when possible. If a handoff to GreenLeaf is required, we'll log the ticket with the following handoff metadata: shift-handled-by, actions-taken, outstanding-blockers, suggested next steps.
3) Morning handback window: between 07:00–09:00 ET the following day. GreenLeaf ops to confirm primary morning responder for each weekday.
4) Escalation path: Redwood L2 -> Redwood Ops Lead (Ben Carter) -> GreenLeaf EM on-call -> Redwood leadership (optional). We'll document explicit phone numbers and PagerDuty escalation keys.

I'm attaching a draft handoff matrix that maps responsibility by hour and severity. Can you confirm the names and the morning overlap window? If that looks good, I'll loop in Marissa to review SLA amendment language and get a one-off signoff.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_night-handoff_matrix_v1.xlsx (XLSX stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Night coverage - temporary handoff waiver request

Looping Ops and legal check:

Logan — this is doable but we should make three adjustments before committing:

- Define clear acceptance criteria for when Redwood must escalate a P2 to P1 (e.g., if impact grows or batch failures cascade).
- Add a fallback route if GreenLeaf morning responder misses the handback window — Redwood should be able to run a mitigation play for an additional 2 hours before auto-closing.
- Explicit SLAs in the amendment should include the exact SLO window and a max number of waived incidents (we should cap at 8 waived P2s over the two-week period).

Marissa — can you draft an amendment clause and align with finance/legal on any crediting we should offer if the waiver correlates with missed incident targets? Laura — can you add the PagerDuty escalation keys and contact list to the matrix?

Thanks — I can approve operationally once the document includes the three items above.

-Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Night coverage - temporary handoff waiver request

Sam —

Thanks for the quick reply and for sharing your runbook. We reviewed internally and are comfortable approving a temporary P2 exception for Oct 4–17 under the following conditions: 

- Agreement on the handoff metadata schema (we've attached the final matrix).
- Maximum of 8 waived P2 incidents during the two-week window. If we exceed that, we will revert to the standard P2 SLA until GreenLeaf increases morning overlap.
- Greenwood to provide a single primary point-of-contact for morning handbacks and a secondary backup; please share PagerDuty IDs by EOD Monday (Oct 4).
- Redwood reserves the right to convert any P2 to a P1 if the incident escalates (impact threshold in the attachment).

If you agree, reply to confirm and we'll generate an official one-off SLA amendment and add it to the GreenLeaf contract folder. We will not bill any additional premium for this operational exception; however, normal usage billing applies.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-escalation-path.pdf (PDF stub)
